MBA Reunion Barcelona 2027
The moment to reunite is here
Barcelona

We are delighted to welcome you back

A special moment to reconnect, reflect, and relive the spirit that shaped your journey


This year, we are honoring the MBA classes of 2022, 2017, 2012, 2007, 2002, 1997, 1992, 1987, 1982, and 1972. We’re also excited to welcome the class of MBA 2024, which is celebrating 1,000 days since graduation.

We have prepared two enriching days, during which you will reconnect with classmates, return to the classroom, learn from MBA success stories, and immerse yourself once again in the vibrant IESE MBA community.
Partners are warmly invited to join.


This event has a fee of 60€/person. 
IESE Alumni Association members have a reduced fee of 30€/person.
